column1: # Lane social-profile, wave 28. Partition src/pages/social/** except groups/**
# and src/components/social/** except feed/**.
# ONE FAMILY, MEASURED ON ALL SIX FRAMES. The "Sample Conversation" family is
# eight catalogued rows. Six of them are the open thread and are drawn by
# src/pages/social/messages/MessageThread.tsx and
# src/pages/social/messages/ConversationHeader.tsx; every node below was opened
# first hand through the Plugin API on 2026-09-06 and no number is carried from
# an earlier row. The other two are NOT thread frames at all - see the
# correction at the bottom of this block.
# WHY THIS FAMILY. Waves 2, 3 and 4 all touched these rows and none measured
# them: wave 2 marked three `done` on "nobody spotted a difference", wave 3
# demoted them to `partial` with "NOT MEASURED", and wave 4 recorded the reason
# nobody could - /messages never paints in dev, because Messages.tsx gates on a
# wallet connect the dev mock cannot complete. That blocks a BROWSER
# measurement. It does not block reading the frame and resolving the class
# strings, which is what this pass did.
# TWO FIXES LANDED, each with its oracle in the same commit and every value
# proved red by an extending mutation, then restored from a file copy:
#   e12338d71  the peer card and the day heading, MessageThread.tsx
#   b9527999d  the header identity, ConversationHeader.tsx
# 175 checks pass across src/pages/social/messages/__tests__ (18 files).
# THE MEASUREMENT BOTH FIXES CAME OUT OF. Nothing in this thread is board
# independent, and the shipped code had one ramp - the 1440 one - for all three:
#   heading gap       32         40         32     thread itemSpacing, either side
# The card ramps are checked against each other: Frame 793 is 14+4+14+4+14 = 50
# 64 avatar on a 14 gap; `middle` adds the 34/34/32 button row on a 24 gap. That
# reproduces 184 / 188 / 194 exactly, and the oracle rebuilds the same sum from
# the classes the component ships rather than asserting the three sizes
# separately - a ramp that reads plausibly per line but composes wrong fails.
# TWO TRAPS THIS PASS WALKED INTO AND OUT OF.
#  · THE HEADING HAD NO FAMILY CLASS. Manrope is this app's `sans`, so a text
#    node with no family draws in it; the frame says Mulish Regular at all three
#    widths. Nothing about the size or colour says so, and the four existing
#    assertions on that element all passed.
#  · `text-[12px]` IS A PREFIX OF `text-[12px]/[14px]`. Both suites asserted the
#    old flat values with `.toContain`, which cannot tell the flat rule from the
#    paired one. They now split className and compare whole tokens.
# THE 44px FLOOR CAUGHT TWO CONTROLS. src/index.css:749 floors every button at
# 44px min-height under `max-width: 768px`, which takes in 768 itself. The
# card's "View profile" is 32 tall at 375 and 34 at 768; the header name is a
# button in a 40-tall row at both. Both now carry the sanctioned `no-min-size`.
# The header's other arms are spans, which is why only a DIRECT conversation
# ever showed the taller row.
# STILL OPEN ON EVERY THREAD ROW, MEASURED BUT NOT FIXED.
#  · THE COLUMN GUTTER. `thread` is inset 16 at 375 (343 of 375), 30 at 768 (708
#    of 768) and 100 at 1440 (728 inside a 928 pane). The file ships a flat
#    `p-4`. It is not fixed here because the 1440 pane is composed by
#    Messages.tsx and ConversationList's own `w-full lg:w-80 xl:w-96` - 384 at
#    1440 against the frame's 454 - so the code's pane is not the frame's pane
#    and a 100px gutter cannot be resolved against it from source alone.
#  · THE GAP UNDER THE PEER CARD. Frame 1000003845 puts `thread` 24 below
#    `middle` at 375 and 768 and 46 at 1440, and `thread`'s first child is the
#    date heading with 0 padding above it. In code the card's `pb-8`, the list's
#    `space-y-1` and the heading's own `pt-7` compose to 64. Matching it needs
#    the heading's top padding suppressed when it is the first thing under the
#    card, which is a structural change, not a value.
#  · THE MESSAGE GROUPS. `thread` spaces its children on the same itemSpacing as
#    the headings (32/40/32) and the list carries `space-y-1`. The bubbles are
#    src/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx, outside this partition.
# ★ CORRECTION - TWO ROWS NAME THE WRONG FILE. 11365:21892 and 11385:27845 are
# titled "Sample Conversation" and the registry points both at MessageThread.tsx.
# Neither draws a thread. Both are the CONVERSATION LIST: their `Frame 285` is a
# run of `content` rows on a 64 (375) / 72 (768) pitch with a zero-height rule
# between each, and neither frame contains a `middle`, a `thread` or an `Input`.
# The two frames that ARE the 375 and 768 threads are 11368:23343 and
# 11387:29051. Left as `partial` with the file corrected in the row rather than
# silently rewritten, because the registry is not this lane's to edit.

column5: FIXED THIS WAVE, both commits touch this frame. (1) PEER CARD RAMP. Figma `middle` 5153:205080 is 330x194: name 5154:206657 Manrope Bold 14/18, handle 5154:206660 and joined 5154:206663 Mulish Regular 12/16, button label I5153:205089;780:133 Manrope Regular 14/18 in a 34-tall button, all at letterSpacing -4%. Code before shipped exactly these values - and shipped them at 375 and 768 too, where the frames draw 12/14 and 12/16. Code after ramps: CARD_NAME `text-[12px]/[14px] md:text-[12px]/[16px] lg:text-[14px]/[18px]`, CARD_META `text-[12px]/[14px] lg:text-[12px]/[16px]`, button `text-[14px]/[16px] md:text-[14px]/[18px]`. AT 1440 THE DELTA WAS AND IS 0 - the oracle rebuilds 64 + 14 + (18+4+16+4+16) + 24 + (18+8+8) = 194 against the frame's 194. (2) DAY HEADING. 5157:207691 is Mulish Regular 12/16 at -4% in #95A09F, and `thread` 5157:207690 carries itemSpacing 32 either side of it. Code before had no font class, so it drew in Manrope - `sans` in modules/skai-ui/src/lib/design-tokens.ts:352 - at 12/16 with `pt-7 pb-7` (28 + the list's `space-y-1` 4 = 32). Code after names `font-mulish` and ramps `lg:text-[12px]/[16px]`; the 32 was already right here and is now stated per board. Family delta 1440: WAS Manrope, IS Mulish. (3) HEADER NAME. Frame 239 5154:206630 is a 40-tall SPACE_BETWEEN row; its `Frame 792` 5154:206643 puts a 40px avatar 14 from 5154:206636, Manrope Bold 14/18 at -4%. Code before was `font-semibold` alone, so it inherited the body's 16px at weight 600. Code after pins HEADER_NAME. ALSO RE-MEASURED AT DELTA 0, both sides resolved: avatar 64 against `h-16 w-16`; `middle` VERTICAL gap 24 against `gap-6`; `Frame 792` gap 14 against `gap-[14px]`; `Frame 793` gap 4 against `gap-1`; button radius 8 / fill #56C7F3 / label #001615 / padding 8-24 against `rounded-[8px] bg-[#56C7F3] text-[#001615] py-2 px-6`; heading fill #95A09F and centring against `text-[#95A09F]` on a `justify-center` row; header avatar 40 against `w-10 h-10`. Frame 242's second CTA/button 5153:205088 is `visible: false` and is correctly not drawn. STILL OPEN: the column gutter (100 each side inside the 928 pane), the 46 between `middle` and `thread`, and the message groups - all three explained in the header block.
